headline: Executive order sets rules for converting the job appointments of ATF criminal investigators, also called special agents.
what_it_does: This order gives the federal government authority to convert the job appointments of special agents at the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives (ATF). No summary was provided, so the exact details are unclear. For example, it is not clear what type of appointment agents are converted from or to, or what conditions apply.

who_it_affects.how: Their federal job appointments may be converted to a different type under the authority this order creates.

who_it_affects.group: Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives
who_it_affects.how: The agency gains a conversion authority it can use for its criminal investigator workforce.

when_it_takes_effect: Not stated in the title; executive orders usually take effect when signed, which was October 3, 2014.
